description: P0 修复后核心能力专项评测。覆盖明确查询、业务口径澄清、多轮恢复、合法关联、歌曲资源交付、安全拒绝与权限隔离。

cases.question: 按订单地区统计平均成交单价
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.region AS 地区, ROUND(AVG(i.unit_price), 2) AS 平均单价 FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY 平均单价 DESC

cases.question: 按店铺所属大区统计SKU销售价的平均值
cases.gold_sql: SELECT s.region AS 地区, ROUND(AVG(ps.sale_price), 2) AS 平均销售价 FROM product_skus ps JOIN products p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id JOIN stores s ON p.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY 平均销售价 DESC

cases.question: 我想了解各地区的销售表现
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region AS 地区, COUNT(order_id) AS 订单量 FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY 订单量 DESC

cases.question: 帮我找出目前还没有配置专属封面的歌曲
cases.gold_sql: SELECT resource_id AS 资源ID, cn_file_name AS 歌曲名称, artist AS 歌手, album AS 专辑, category AS 歌曲分类, image_path AS 当前封面 FROM media_resources WHERE image_path = 'public_third_part.jpeg' ORDER BY resource_id

cases.question: 帮我找出没有封面地址的歌曲
cases.gold_sql: SELECT resource_id AS 资源ID, cn_file_name AS 歌曲名称, image_path AS 当前封面 FROM media_resources WHERE image_path IS NULL OR TRIM(image_path) = '' ORDER BY resource_id

cases.question: 按订单地区统计各商品分类的销量
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.region AS 地区, c.category_name AS 商品分类, SUM(i.quantity) AS 销量 FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY o.region, c.category_name ORDER BY o.region, 销量 DESC

按下单时间统计2026年7月各地区的订单量
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region AS 地区, COUNT(order_id) AS 订单量 FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY 订单量 DESC
